test_description: Verify 'Last Write Wins' conflict resolution when client updates stale data
business_risk: Critical - Data corruption or loss of user progress
preconditions: User logged in; Device offline; Server record updated by another device
test_steps: 1. Fetch Book A (v1) on Device 1; 2. Update Book A on Device 2 (v2) & Sync; 3. Update Book A on Device 1 (offline); 4. Connect Device 1 & Sync
expected_result: Server accepts Device 1 update if client timestamp > server timestamp; otherwise server rejects and sends v2 back
test_data_needs: Two distinct device sessions; Pre-seeded library item
tools_required: Flutter Integration Test; Mock Web Server; Isar Inspector
dependencies: Sync API Endpoint; Local Isar DB
success_criteria: Data consistency across all devices; Zero data loss

test_description: Verify Idempotency of App Store Webhook Processing
business_risk: Critical - Revenue reporting errors; Incorrect user entitlement
preconditions: Subscription Service running; Mocked App Store Webhook sender
test_steps: 1. Send 'DID_RENEW' webhook payload; 2. Verify User Role = Premium; 3. Resend exact same webhook payload; 4. Verify no duplicate DB writes or logic errors
expected_result: First request returns 200 OK & updates DB; Second request returns 200 OK but performs no DB action
test_data_needs: Valid signed Apple JWS payload mock
success_criteria: Idempotency confirmed; Audit log reflects duplicate attempt
failure_impact: Medium - Data bloat; Potential race conditions

test_description: Verify RAG Pipeline Latency under load
business_risk: High - Premium user churn due to slow UX
preconditions: OpenSearch index populated; 100 concurrent users simulating requests
test_steps: 1. Initiate 100 concurrent POST /recommendations; 2. Measure P95 response time; 3. Validate response structure
expected_result: P95 latency < 3000ms; No 5xx errors; Fallback triggered if timeout
